correctness.rationale: In convolution Banach algebra ℓ1, G_y=(1−y)/(1−yz), A_y=∂_y log G_y and ∥A′_y∥1=2/(1−y)², ∥A″_y∥1=4/(1−y)³. Along y_j=w+t δ_j, Σδ_j=0 cancels the linear response, giving ∥P′_t∥1≤2t S2/a², hence TV≤S2/(2a²). Compare P′_t with t S2 P_0*A′_w, control differences by 2t³S2²/a⁴+2t²S3/a³ and integrate to obtain S3/(3a³)+S2²/(4a⁴). The convolution term is exactly shifted NB(c+2) minus NB(c), with zero mass. Its signed mass changes at k(k−1)=c(c+1)w²/(1−w)², yielding the tail difference and strictly positive local leading constant for nonzero v.
